parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid of the kettle, made of stainless steel, typically circular and slightly domed to fit snugly on top of the kettle body.
parts.Functional_description: It covers the opening of the kettle to retain heat and prevent water from spilling or evaporating too quickly.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or rotated slightly to open or close the kettle.

parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: The handle of the kettle, made of heat-resistant Bakelite, curved for ergonomic grip.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to safely lift and pour the kettle without touching the hot metal body.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed to the kettle body and does not move independently.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main body of the kettle, made of stainless steel, includes the spout and the main water chamber.
parts.Functional_description: It holds and heats the water, and directs the flow through the spout when pouring.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part that does not move; it serves as the structural core of the kettle.
